scope: Maintained entry points and user/developer guides. Historical archives are preserved, not exhaustively relinted.

findings.problem: The root mixed setup/status detail before user workflows.
findings.resolution: Adapt the short opening, examples-first flow, capabilities, comparison, install and scope from ryf/agent-youtube; copy no unrelated capabilities or measurements.

findings.problem: Current entry points still claimed Actions were paused and required skip-ci.
findings.resolution: Align the maintained guides and contributor policy with enabled hosted checks. Preserve dated historical reports unchanged.

findings.problem: Published 0.10.1 and unpublished gapless changes share a Cargo version.
findings.resolution: Distinguish archive versus checkout, pin the published API guide/examples, and record actual registry source/checksum resolution.

findings.problem: The lab index still said no native Apple host was available.
findings.resolution: Link actual two-cell macOS LC gapless results; keep broader quality/timing/HE and mobile-runtime qualification distinct.

findings.problem: Usage mixed task guidance, release notes and historical validation.
findings.resolution: Separate usage from verification, retain negative consumer findings, and preserve old section anchors as relocation pointers.

findings.problem: The example checker accepted exactly one Rust block and did not report resolved archive provenance.
findings.resolution: Compile all three Rust examples against exact crates.io 0.10.1, execute two, type-check no_run file I/O, verify registry/checksum, and check MSRV with disposable apps under target/.

findings.problem: There was no maintained-doc link/anchor gate.
findings.resolution: Add offline verification of local links, anchors, aliases, linked images and repository URLs mapped to this checkout; exercise failures and enable policy/CI checks.

findings.problem: Dated coverage and earlier platform gaps were blended with current status.
findings.resolution: Move 92.71% and 93.88% measurements/exclusions into verification, remove the stale-coverage badge, and distinguish pinned hosted runs from the main badge.

findings.problem: Checkpoint wording could imply automatic source authentication or tag-only eligibility.
findings.resolution: Make caller source/options/exact-build authentication explicit and distinguish the release edit-list boundary from the checkout tag window; tag-only checkpoint exclusion remains.

findings.problem: The root integration table named syom 0.10.0 while 0.10.1 was published.
findings.resolution: Update the integration row only. Retain peer review date 2026-11-02 and original 0.8.0 timings, including the unfavorable HE v2 cell; claim no new benchmark or ranking.

findings.problem: Root README is also the crate rustdoc landing page; bare repository-file URLs can resolve relative to the API site instead of the repository.
findings.resolution: Use repository URLs for root README source/license/benchmark/contributor links. The offline checker maps these URLs to checkout files and validates their targets.

validation_boundaries: Link checking validates the checkout, including mapped GitHub main URLs; new unmerged pages need not already be on remote main.
External peer facts remain the pinned 2026-11-02 source review, not latest-release recommendations.
The file example is compiled, not executed against an unspecified user file.
Two self-contained examples run against the registry archive, separately from checkout doctests.
Runtime codec source, Cargo versions, lockfiles, fixtures and historical measurements are unchanged.
No new codec speed, coverage, quality or mobile-runtime measurement is claimed.
